NAME:
   sdd info - Show session framing — participant, language, search capability

USAGE:
   sdd info [options]

OPTIONS:
   --format string  Output format: text (default) or json (default: "text")
   --help, -h       show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --version                      Print the version
   --graph-dir string, -d string  Override graph directory (auto-discovered from .sdd/config.yaml)
   --local-config string          Use this file as the machine-local config layer instead of .sdd/config.local.yaml (read and written)
   --verbose, -v                  Enable info-level logging
   --extra-verbose, --vv          Enable debug-level logging
   --timing                       Print how long each phase of the command takes to stderr [$SDD_TIMING]
